summary: Full backend + frontend testing of MS Park Intranet MVP. 21/21 backend API tests pass. Frontend: dashboard, sidebar nav, points-repas (UX rule respected: no online clock-in, on-site message present), restaurant flow with cart→QR modal, planning, badgeage, demandes, notifications drawer, messagerie, documents, agenda, avantages, contacts, profil all render. Found and fixed CRITICAL crash in Actualités (useEffect returning Promise broke whole React tree). Two minor non-blocking issues: DOM nesting (button-in-button in order modal) and testid naming mismatch for notifications.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent — useEffect(refresh, []) returned a Promise from .then(), causing 'destroy is not a function' on cleanup and crashing the whole React tree (white page + all navigation broken after visiting /actualites)

Invalid DOM nesting: <button> (modal backdrop with onClick) contains a child <button> (action button). Triggers React hydration error 'cannot be a descendant'. Replace outer <button> with a <div role="dialog"> + key handler.

integration_issues.issue: Header bell uses data-testid='notif-button' (not 'notifications-bell' as listed in review). Drawer opens correctly, 'Tout marquer lu' works. Likely just a naming inconsistency with the spec.

issues: Spec asks for verbatim text 'badgeage uniquement sur site' — the page uses 'Le badgeage est uniquement disponible sur site via votre badge employé' which conveys the same intent (acceptable). No online clock-in button is present (compliant).

action_items: Fix invalid DOM nesting in Restaurant.jsx order-modal: replace the outer <button> overlay with a <div role='dialog' onClick=close> to avoid nested-button hydration error
(Optional) Rename data-testid 'notif-button' → 'notifications-bell' and add 'notifications-drawer' on the drawer aside for spec alignment
(Optional) Update Points Repas to display the exact spec text 'Badgeage uniquement sur site' as a more prominent label
critical_code_review_comments: useEffect(refresh, []) anti-pattern: passing a function that returns a Promise to useEffect causes React to treat the return as a cleanup function — always wrap with `() => { refresh(); }`. Found and fixed in Actualites.jsx; Demandes.jsx uses the same form but its refresh has no implicit return (safe). Recommend lint rule.
server.py is one 1300+ line file — recommend splitting into routers (employees, schedule, meal_points, orders, social, requests, documents, notifications, messaging, calendar).
Order surcharge computation could divide by zero in edge cases; current code guards with `if total_points else 0` — OK.
No error boundary around routed pages — a single component crash unmounts the whole app (as observed with Actualités).
All /api endpoints correctly strip MongoDB _id via projection {'_id': 0} or _strip helper — verified, no ObjectId leakage.

seed_data_creation: None — backend auto-seeds idempotently via _seed_once() at startup. Tests create transient TEST_-prefixed posts/comments/requests/messages; harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file is /app/backend/tests/test_mspark_api.py — 21 tests, all passing. Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Frontend testids verified: status-pill, kpi-{week,presence,notif,docs}, news-carousel, carousel-{next,prev}, see-planning, qa-points, nav-{dashboard,points,restaurant,planning,badge,demandes,news,messagerie,documents,agenda,avantages,contacts,profil}, notif-button (not notifications-bell), open-cart, cart-drawer, place-order, order-modal, store-{soccer_bar,donut_house,stand_crepes,stand_bonbons}, new-request, post-{id}, like-{id}, channel-ch-accueil. After fix, Actualités now shows 5 seeded posts and like toggle works.
rca of the issue: Actualités white-page crash — root cause: `useEffect(refresh, [])` where `refresh = () => api.get('/posts').then(...)`. The arrow function returned a Promise; React stored it as the cleanup. At unmount/dependency change React called `promise()` which threw 'destroy is not a function', triggering an unhandled error that unmounted the whole router. Mitigation applied: wrapped in `useEffect(() => { refresh(); }, [])`. Reproduction: navigate to /actualites; before fix → blank screen + console pageerror 'destroy is not a function'; after fix → 5 posts render, likes/comments work.
